{{Infobox/Item |rarity=e |auctionable=y |tradeable=y |lower_tier=Juicy Sprayonator |raw_materials = *1 Sprayonator *30720 Melon Slice *96 Salted Sunflower Seeds *11000 Copper |raw_materials_upgr = *96 Salted Sunflower Seeds *10000 Copper |museum=yes |museum_xp=8 |museum_category=farming |id=SALTY_SPRAYONATOR |other_level_requirement={{skill|Garden V}} }} A '''Salty Sprayonator''' is an {{Epic}} item. == Obtaining == A '''Salty Sprayonator''' can be purchased from [[SkyMart]] for {{Item|Juicy Sprayonator|amount=1}}, {{Item|Salty Nozzle|amount=1}}, and {{Copper|10000}}. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sprayonator |name = Salty Sprayonator |rarity = e |item_ability_name = Configure |item_ability_description = Select a nozzle and material for spraying. Certain materials attract certain types of {{mt|pest|Pests}}. |item_ability_activation = Left Click |item_ability_name2 = Spray |item_ability_description2 = Sprays your selected material onto the {{Green|Garden}} plot you are on. Lasts for {{Green|60m}}.
{{DarkPurple|Salty Nozzle Bonus:}}
{{DarkGray|➜}} {{Stat|bonus pest chance|+75}} while in a sprayed plot.
{{DarkGray|➜}} {{mt|pest|Pests}} are {{Green|3x}} more likely to spawn in sprayed plots. |item_ability_activation2 = Right Click |item_ability_cooldown2 = 3s }} The '''Salty Sprayonator''' can be used to spray a [[Garden]] plot for {{Green|60}} minutes using {{Item|Compost}}, {{Item|Plant Matter}}, {{Item|Dung}}, {{Item|Honey Jar}}, {{Item|Tasty Cheese}}, or {{Item|Jelly}}. {{:Sprayonator/Usage}} === Nozzles === Additional effects are applied in sprayed plots depending on the selected nozzle: * {{Item|Basic Nozzle|link=}}: Consumes {{Green|1}} of the material. Grants {{Stat|bonus pest chance|+25}} while in a sprayed plot. Pests are {{Green|1.5x}} more likely to spawn in sprayed plots. * {{Item|Juicy Nozzle}}: Consumes {{Green|3}} of the material. Grants {{Stat|bonus pest chance|+50}} while in a sprayed plot. Pests are {{Green|2x}} more likely to spawn in sprayed plots. * {{Item|Salty Nozzle}}: Consumes {{Green|5}} of the material. Grants {{Stat|bonus pest chance|+75}} while in a sprayed plot.
